metadata.title: Tri Tue Viet Tutoring Centre — 1-on-1, small group and online
metadata.description: Tri Tue Viet supports students from grade 6 to 12 with personalised learning paths, dedicated teachers and clear progress commitments.

hero.title: A learning path that fits, with progress you can see
hero.subtitle: Tri Tue Viet builds an individual plan for every student — entry assessment, the right class, and regular progress reports for parents.

courses.title: Courses by subject and grade
courses.description: Each subject has its own path per grade, aligned with the national curriculum and real exam papers.

items.name: Mathematics
items.description: Algebra, geometry and focused drilling on the question types that matter per grade.

items.name: Literature
items.description: Reading comprehension, social and literary essays following the current exam format.

items.name: English
items.description: Grammar foundations, topic vocabulary and exam technique.

items.name: Physics
items.description: Formula systems, applied problems and demonstrative experiments.

items.name: Chemistry
items.description: Equations, reaction chains and fully worked chemistry problems.

items.name: Transition exam prep
items.description: Accelerated paths for the grade 10 entrance exam and the high school graduation exam.

formats.title: Pick the format that suits your child
formats.description: Four formats, the same teacher quality and the same progress reporting.

items.name: One-on-one
items.description: The teacher focuses entirely on one student and adjusts pace lesson by lesson.

items.name: Small group of 3 – 6
items.description: More affordable, still closely supervised, with peer motivation added.

items.name: Online classes
items.description: Live lessons with recordings, suited to distance or a busy schedule.

items.name: Home tutoring
items.description: The teacher comes to your home on a schedule you set.
